title: See the finished page
instructions: Use this as your target layout (1280×780). Match spacing before fine-tuning formats.

title: Step 1 — Slicers
instructions: Insert → Slicer. Add **Stores** (storelocations.name), **Sales Team** (Salesteams), **Products** (Products_Data). Place top-right; set dropdown style.

title: Step 2 — KPI cards
instructions: Insert → Card for each measure: Total Sales, Profit Margin %, Total Orders, % of Target (monthly), Average Daily Sales. Use the DAX block list for formulas.

title: Step 3 — Profit composition
instructions: Insert → 100% stacked bar. Values: Total Cost & Total Profit measures (see DAX). Place under Profit Margin card.

title: Step 4 — Sales trend
instructions: Insert → Line chart. Axis: Date Table[Date]. Values: Total Sales. Add month buttons + D/W/M bookmarks (optional).

title: Step 5 — Toast notification
instructions: Add HTML Content custom visual. Bind **Toast Notification** and **Toast CSS** measures from the DAX list.
